channel.title: Equationarium
channel.description: Equationarium – beautiful by accident, true by law.

item.title: Mathematical Mandala No.11 – 8-Fold Symmetry Geometric Line Art
item.description: A trochoid (the Spirograph curve, also behind guilloché engraving) with a small 10:1 Lissajous wobble, rotated into 8-fold symmetry.

item.title: Snowflake No.02 – Hexagonal Ice Crystal Growth Line Art
item.description: Each cell holds some water vapor. Cells next to the ice gain a little vapor every step; the rest share it with their neighbours. Where vapor arrives fastest, the crystal reaches out, and the arms branch. The six-fold symmetry comes from the hexagonal lattice, not from copying.
